preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.
The number of Catowice residents is between 1 and 1,000,000.
The number of friendship pairs between residents and cats is between 1 and 1,000,000.
Each resident and each cat is numbered between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: Each pair of some resident and some cat is listed at most once.
preconditions.description: There are no duplicate friendship pairs.

preconditions.expression: For every i there exists a pair between i-th resident and i-th cat.
preconditions.description: Each resident is acquainted with their own cat.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases is at most 1,000,000.
preconditions.description: The total number of residents across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of m over all test cases is at most 1,000,000.
preconditions.description: The total number of friendship pairs across all test cases is at most 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' to indicate whether it's possible to select the jury and contestants.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes', then j + p = n
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the sum of the number of jury members and the number of contestants must equal the total number of residents and cats.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes', then each resident in the jury is not acquainted with any contestant
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', each resident selected as a jury member must not be acquainted with any cat selected as a contestant.

postconditions.expression: if output is 'Yes', then the output contains a valid selection of jury and contestants
postconditions.description: If the output is 'Yes', the output must contain a valid selection of jury and contestants that satisfies the conditions.

invariants.expression: Each resident is acquainted with exactly one cat.
invariants.description: Each resident is acquainted with exactly one cat, and each cat is acquainted with exactly one resident.
